TEASER-CARD Another Person Beta was remanded on Monday over alleged procurement fraud at a state agency, the third such case this year, a court official said. The court refused bail and adjourned the case to the end of the month.

TEASER-MORE Prosecutors told the court that the contracts were awarded without tender and that the accused had signed each of them, a claim the defence rejected as untested and premature at this stage of the proceedings.

TEASER-LAST The case returns to court next month, when the prosecution is expected to call the first of its eleven witnesses and to tender the audit report in evidence.
